name: board
description: A six-step method, each step a separate command that writes one file in a dossier and checks the previous one: /board:cadrage (framing and web check of the counterpart), /board:base (one single call: verdict, decisive questions as trees, hypotheses ranked with the cheapest test), /board:acteurs (one call that plays each actor of the value chain from his chair), /board:angles (critique from 2 to 4 described ways of judging, one call), /board:livrable (the one-page document), /board:terrain (field debrief and scoring). /board:suite says what comes next. Rules in references/principes.md.
